title: Elbit Systems Signed Contracts with an International Customer Valued at Approximately $270 Million for Advanced ISR & Targeting Payloads
body_markdown:
Elbit Systems Ltd. announced today that it has signed contracts with an international customer, in an aggregate value of approximately $270 million, in the field of advanced ISR & Targeting payloads, to be performed over a period of up to six years.


Under the contracts, Elbit Systems will supply systems from its[SPECTRO™ family](https://www.elbitsystems.com/unmanned/maritime/usv-payloads/spectro) of multi-spectral electro-optic Intelligence, Surveillance, Target Acquisition and Reconnaissance (“ISTAR”) solutions. The[SPECTRO](https://www.elbitsystems.com/unmanned/maritime/usv-payloads/spectro) systems integrate Mid-Wave Infrared (MWIR), Visible and Short-Wave Infrared (SWIR) high-definition imaging channels, advanced laser designation capabilities and AI-based analytics technologies, enabling advanced target identification, tracking and long-range intelligence gathering capabilities for airborne, naval and ground applications, while maintaining a compact configuration operable day and night and in adverse weather conditions.


In addition, Elbit Systems will supply[AMPS™ NG](https://www.elbitsystems.com/air-space/airborne-c4isr/electro-optical-intelligence-systems/amps-ng) systems from the[SPECTRO family](https://www.elbitsystems.com/unmanned/maritime/usv-payloads/spectro) for airborne Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (“ISR”) and Targeting missions featuring advanced imaging channels. The[AMPS NG](https://www.elbitsystems.com/air-space/airborne-c4isr/electro-optical-intelligence-systems/amps-ng) systems provide extremely long-range target acquisition, surveillance and geo-location capabilities through the integration of MWIR, Visible and SWIR sensors, together with advanced image processing and highly accurate geo-pointing technologies, supporting strategic ISR and Targeting missions in complex operational environments.


> **Bezhalel (Butzi) Machlis, President and CEO of Elbit Systems:** "Elbit Systems is a global leader in the field of ISR & Targeting solutions, providing modern armed forces with a comprehensive portfolio of advanced capabilities designed to address a wide range of operational requirements. Through our innovative technologies, we enable customers to enhance situational awareness, intelligence gathering and mission effectiveness in today’s complex operational environments."
